credits.title: LifeLike
credits.overview: For the terminally ill Izzet, time is nearly up. Doctors have given up, prayers and rituals offer little help, and his family's future is now in God's hands. So Izzet spends his time in virtual reality, roaming through the astonishing and otherworldly places of the virtual cosmos. He even meets his girlfriend there…

credits.title: Under the Blanket
credits.overview: Yankı is a 17-year-old gay boy. He is under pressure because of his sexual orientation from the neighborhood and his mother. One day, his mom and a neighbor decide to solve this problem. (Wicked Queer Film Festival 2020)

credits.title: Secret
credits.overview: Mahir, a musician renowned with his proud personality, has been having a secret romantic relationship with her daughter’s friend Duru. Duru’s father Ali is a traditional, family-oriented man. Mahir and Duru drift apart in their fear while Ali is just about to learn of their secret relationship.

credits.overview: Kadife, a beautiful but troubled village girl, finds a young man lying unconscious by the river one day. When the young man regains consciousness, it becomes clear that he has lost his memory...
